title: Clone source: Glass transition settings

fields.label: Glass
fields.message: Glass — the look of the wavy panels and the flat section body.

fields.label: Layers
fields.name: layers
fields.instructions: How many stacked wave panels per edge.

fields.label: Tint colour
fields.name: tint
fields.instructions: Colour of the glass. Darker reads as shadow; lighter reads as frost.

fields.label: Layer opacity
fields.name: opacity
fields.instructions: Opacity of each panel. Panels stack, so the deepest part of the transition is darker.

fields.label: Backdrop blur
fields.name: blur
fields.instructions: How much the site background (orbs) is blurred behind the glass.

fields.label: Backdrop saturation
fields.name: saturation
fields.instructions: 100% = none. Higher makes the orbs glow through more vividly.

fields.label: Backdrop brightness
fields.name: brightness
fields.instructions: Below 100% darkens what shows through.

fields.label: Crest highlight
fields.name: edge
fields.instructions: A thin lit rim along the top of each wave, like light catching glass. 0 = off.

fields.label: Crest highlight thickness
fields.name: edge_width
fields.instructions: Thickness of that rim.

fields.label: Shape
fields.message: Shape — the wave silhouettes. Waves are generated from these numbers.

fields.label: Transition height
fields.name: height
fields.instructions: Height of each wavy edge (also the space it takes up on the page).

fields.label: Height on phones
fields.name: mobile_scale
fields.instructions: Scales height and wavelength below 720px wide.

fields.label: Wave height
fields.name: peak
fields.instructions: How much of the transition height the waves occupy.

fields.label: Wavelength
fields.name: length
fields.instructions: Width of one repeating wave tile. Longer = broader, calmer waves.

fields.label: Complexity
fields.name: complexity
fields.instructions: 1 = smooth single swell. 4 = choppier, more organic.

fields.label: Seed
fields.name: seed
fields.instructions: Change to get a different set of wave shapes.

fields.label: Layer spacing
fields.name: spacing
fields.instructions: Resting vertical offset between panels. 0 = all wave tops aligned.

fields.label: Blend into section
fields.name: fade
fields.instructions: How much of the transition’s lower part fades into the flat section body.

fields.label: Motion
fields.message: Motion — the slow float and the scroll response. Visitors can pause all motion with the site’s pause button, and reduced-motion settings turn it off.

fields.label: Animate waves
fields.name: animate
fields.instructions: Slow horizontal drift + gentle bobbing.

fields.label: Drift duration
fields.name: drift_duration
fields.instructions: Seconds for one wave tile to slide by. Bigger = slower.

fields.label: Drift variation
fields.name: drift_variance
fields.instructions: How different each layer’s speed is.

fields.label: Bob distance
fields.name: bob
fields.instructions: How far each panel floats up and down. 0 = none.

fields.label: Bob duration
fields.name: bob_duration
fields.instructions: Seconds per up-and-down float.

fields.label: Motion update rate
fields.name: motion_rate
fields.instructions: How many times per second the waves move. The drift is so slow that 5 looks smooth but uses a fraction of the CPU/GPU (glass blur is re-computed on every update). 60 = fully smooth, highest power use.

fields.label: Scroll parallax
fields.name: parallax_mode

choices.spread: Spread — tops start aligned, fan out as you scroll
choices.collapse: Collapse — start spread out, come together as you scroll
choices.drift: Drift — layers slide past each other at different speeds

fields.instructions: How the wave layers react to scrolling.

fields.label: Parallax travel
fields.name: parallax_strength
fields.instructions: How far the deepest layer moves. Negative reverses direction (and needs more transition height so nothing clips).

description: Reused by Site Options and the Accent Section block through a Clone field. Not shown on any screen.
